name: Brown University — Global Brown Center
description: For Fulbright applicants, alumni, and visiting scholars connected to Brown, the Global Brown Center offers international community programming and a natural networking node for cross-cultural engagement in Providence.

name: URI in the World — International Center
description: For Fulbright applicants and partners at URI, this global education hub connects study abroad, international exchange, and faculty-led programming that can support applicant preparation and visiting-scholar engagement.

name: World Affairs Council of Rhode Island
description: For Fulbright alumni and applicants interested in diplomacy, global affairs, and civic exchange, WACRI offers speaker programs and a Rhode Island network for internationally minded community engagement.

name: WACRI Global Ties / IVLP
description: For Fulbright alumni and community partners who want to host, brief, or collaborate with international visitors, WACRI's Global Ties work connects State Department delegations with Rhode Island institutions.

name: RI Bio
description: For Fulbright applicants and alumni in life sciences, biotech, and public health, RI Bio is a statewide network for industry events, research translation, and career or collaboration connections.

name: RI Life Science Hub
description: For Fulbright-linked researchers, founders, and health innovators, the RI Life Science Hub offers a path into Rhode Island's commercialization, funding, and partnership ecosystem.

name: NEMIC — New England Medical Innovation Center
description: For Fulbright researchers and alumni in medtech, public health, or clinical innovation, NEMIC provides Providence-based advising and commercialization support for translating ideas into health technology.

name: Ocean State Labs (Portal Innovations)
description: For Fulbright alumni or partners building biotech and medtech collaborations, Ocean State Labs is a Providence-based incubator node for lab access, company formation, and research translation.

name: Rhode Island Commerce
description: For Fulbright alumni, applicants, and institutional partners exploring how global research or exchange can create local impact, RI Commerce is the statewide economic-development entry point for business assistance, sector partnerships, and innovation resources.

name: Rhode Island Commerce — Innovation Programs
description: For Fulbright applicants and alumni pursuing research translation, entrepreneurship, or policy-impact work, RI Commerce innovation programs can support R&D partnerships, vouchers, and commercialization pathways.

name: I-195 District (Providence Innovation District)
description: For Fulbright-linked founders, researchers, and institutional partners, the I-195 District is Rhode Island's innovation corridor for lab space, startup infrastructure, and cross-sector collaboration.

name: RIHub (state startup resource)
description: For Fulbright alumni exploring venture creation or social-impact entrepreneurship in Rhode Island, RIHub is a startup-network node for founder programming and ecosystem navigation.

name: Rhode Island Sea Grant
description: For Fulbright applicants and alumni in oceanography, coastal resilience, fisheries, or marine policy, Rhode Island Sea Grant connects URI research with public-facing coastal and sustainability work.

name: URI Coastal Institute
description: For Fulbright researchers working on climate, coasts, and environmental resilience, the URI Coastal Institute is a collaboration node connecting interdisciplinary scholarship with applied solutions.

name: RI State Climate Office
description: For Fulbright applicants and alumni focused on climate science, adaptation, or environmental policy, the RI State Climate Office offers state-level data and context for local research translation.

name: Pell Center for International Relations and Public Policy
description: For Fulbright applicants and alumni in diplomacy, public policy, security, and civic life, the Pell Center offers Rhode Island programming connected to international relations and democratic governance.

name: Brown Rhodes Center for International Economics and Finance
description: For Fulbright applicants and alumni working on economics, development, finance, or global policy, the Rhodes Center provides Brown-based research and events connecting international systems to local questions.

name: Rhode Island State Council on the Arts (RISCA)
description: For Fulbright applicants and alumni in arts, culture, and community practice, RISCA is a statewide node for cultural sustainability, arts funding, and intercultural programming.

name: RISD Museum
description: For Fulbright applicants and alumni in arts, design, museum studies, and cultural exchange, RISD Museum offers a Providence anchor for global collections, public programming, and institutional collaboration.
